minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  MINUTES
  November 22, 2019

A special meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Friday, November
22, 2019, at 9:04 am in the City Council Community Room A, 1st Floor

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk
  Eddy Ikemefuna, Planning & Building Department

  Staff Present:  Peggy Velasquez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee,
provided the item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License
Committee.
Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Item #1:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the permit request for
  City of Inglewood, Parks, Recreation and Library Services to host the City’s
  Annual Tree Lighting Ceremony at City Hall, South Mall, December 5, 2019
  from 6:00 pm – 9:00 pm, subject to IPD Watch Commander will be notified
  and extra patrol requested as time permits; Parks & Recreation staff is
  responsible for maintaining and managing crowd control; maintain site at
  all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the
  event; ensure safe pedestrian and vehicular circulation on/off site; adhere
  to all applicable IMC rules and regulations. Motion carried unanimously.
  (Activity No. 00278180)

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 9:06 am.

  Respectfully submitted,
  Peggy L. Velasquez, Recording Secretary
